packageRules.description: Upper bounds on pnpm-workspace.yaml overrides are decisions, not drift: cross-major proposals wait under Pending Approval instead of opening a branch. Routine majors only; CONTRIBUTING.md explains the CI step that covers the rest.

Hold wasm-bindgen and js-sys in packages/cachekit-core-wasm. Both are exact-pinned, and scripts/build.sh fails unless the wasm-bindgen CLI equals the locked wasm-bindgen. CI downloads that CLI by WASM_BINDGEN_VERSION and WASM_BINDGEN_SHA256 in ci.yml, build-wasm.yml and release-please.yml, so the two pins, Cargo.lock and those three workflow pins move together by hand. A Renovate update moves only the crates and fails the wasm build, so it waits under Pending Approval on the Dependency Dashboard instead. Vulnerability updates are not held.

napi, napi-derive and napi-build update in their own napi-rs group, out of all-minor-patch. napi-rs releases napi, napi-derive and napi-derive-backend together, and a new napi-derive-backend can generate calls that only the napi released with it provides. minimumReleaseAge holds napi back for five days, but Cargo.lock takes the newest napi-derive-backend at once because it is transitive, so for up to five days after such a release the pair does not build: napi-derive-backend 6.1.6 calls napi::bindgen_prelude::defer_native_borrow_scope, which napi 3.14.2 lacks, and cachekit-core-ts failed with E0425. In its own group that window fails only the napi-rs PR, and the first Renovate run after napi clears the release age brings the matching napi.
